name: Bidri metalwork
about: This is a silver-inlay craft from the Deccan region, and Hyderabad is known for it. Artisans inlay silver into blackened metal to create its patterns.
tip: Check that the silver inlay is real, not a printed pattern.

name: Pearls
about: Hyderabad has long been a center for pearl trade. Shoppers come here for pearls in many sizes and styles.
tip: Check the size, luster, and authenticity before you buy.

name: Karachi Bakery biscuits
about: Karachi Bakery is a well-known Hyderabad bakery famous for its biscuits. A box makes an easy gift to take home.
